decision.reason: The computed diff behind sc-a121f4492c54 says only "removed [], added [escalation, schedule, team, teams, user]". It does not show the prior schema, so it cannot tell whether an enum was newly added to an unconstrained field (tightened) or an existing enum was extended (loosened). The deterministic semvalidate.crd check against the two CRD artifacts [ev-3cc85997b394] [ev-197df9b33168] even reports that the enum of this field is unchanged, which contradicts the diff. The evidence excerpts themselves are empty ("---"). To settle the change type, we need the actual enum (or its absence) for spec.receivers[].opsgenieConfigs[].responders[].type in both the v0.85.0 and v0.86.2 alertmanagerconfigs CRDs.
